name: Tokyo → Osaka → Hokkaido
tagline: Always together: 4 nights in Shinjuku, one short Hakone–Fuji car trip, an Osaka apartment with a night in Nagoya and a last ryokan night in Nara Park, and 4 nights in Hokkaido.
summary: 4 nights in Nishi-Shinjuku with a slow Akihabara day, a full anime day and a Type R day: Pegasis drives a Civic Type R to Yako, Kawasaki, Yokohama Chinatown and Daikoku, then swaps it for a Toyota with winter tyres for the Turnpike and Fuji. One Fuji-view villa night, then the car goes back at Mishima and a direct Kodama takes you to Osaka for the Nara hill fire. Suzuka, then one night in Nagoya and a full day at Ghibli Park; back in Osaka for Nintendo, Pokémon and the game floors of Umeda and Shinsaibashi, Den Den Town and a Matsusaka beef dinner, and a last ryokan night inside Nara Park. A JAL flight from Itami to Hokkaido: 2 nights in a container house in Niseko town for skiing (Pegasis teaches Aoki), the Rusutsu drift course, then 2 nights in Sapporo, and a Peach flight to Narita for both flights home. You do everything together, every meal has a named place, and every train and bus has its departure time.

who.pegasis: In: 23 of 25 WANTs. Daikoku (you drive, no guide) + Tatsumi, Turnpike, Taikanzan, Otome Pass, Gotemba outlets (plain shopping, 45 min), TMG view, airport bus instead of N'EX, Omoide/Golden Gai, Isetan half-price food, Radio Kaikan, Maidreamin, Ikebukuro goods route, Nakano, SHELTER with a live show, Nara hill fire, Suzuka EV kart and the Tokaido car road (as Hakone–Fuji by car + Suzuka + Nagoya), Niseko Grand Hirafu, Rusutsu drift (30-min self-drive course at 15:00), GARAKU, Moiwa, Daruma. Out: Asahiyama penguins (5 h of travel), Onuma (2 h south of Niseko, a whole extra day). Your maybes in: Lake Kawaguchi, Shibuya Sky, the Kawasaki GBC walk. Because you travel together, you now also join some short stops you marked not interested: Suga stairs (15 min), Nissan Crossing (25 min), Fuji Motorsports Museum (1 h), Toyota museum (1 h). Enoshima, Fushimi Inari and Kinkakuji are out (you both decided). Nijo Market is out (no split on the last day).
who.aoki: In: about 43 of 49 WANTs. Omoide/Golden Gai, Suga stairs, Tokyo Station dome and Hachiko (GBC Tokyo), Nissan Crossing, TMG, Radio Kaikan, ZEST, Nakano and used goods, Ikebukuro, Shimokita and a SHELTER live show, Shibuya Sky at sunset, Nintendo and Pokémon (in Osaka, LUCUA SOUTH and Shinsaibashi), the Kawasaki GBC stamp walk, Daikoku + Tatsumi, Hakone as Tokyo-3, Fuji Motorsports Museum, Lake Kawaguchi, Hanz villa, Yuru Camp Motosu, Nara fire, Suzuka, Toyota museum, Grand Front Osaka (the Sabbat of the Witch mall, a short stop), Namba food, Den Den Town, Liberty Walk (the Osaka city shop; the Sennan JDM Park is 1 h 30 each way), Donki coupon, one and a half ski days at Niseko on the beginner area (Pegasis teaches you, no paid lesson), Rusutsu drift (back seat), Moiwa, Daruma. You also join Pegasis's Taikanzan and Gotemba outlets (short stops you marked not interested). Yokohama Chinatown (dinner before Daikoku). Out: Enoshima and the Slam Dunk crossing, Fushimi Inari and Kinkakuji (you both decided), Cup Noodles Museum (it closes at 18:00, too early for the Kawasaki day), Fujiten ski (Niseko instead), the paid maid-café tour (the Akihabara maid café instead), Cape Kamui (path closed in winter), Aokana/Goto (off route), Toyota Kaikan (closed Sundays). Uji is skipped because you marked it not interested.

info.value: 5 min from Nippombashi Station exit 6 / Nagahoribashi exit 7

tips: Suitcases sent from Tokyo on Jan 21 wait here: write the check-in date (1/23) and your name on the Yamato slip.
Ask the front to keep both suitcases on Jan 24 while you sleep in Nagoya.
The hot-spring bath is optional.

places.ja: 東大寺
places.blurb: The giant bronze Buddha in one of the largest wooden buildings in the world, with the Nara deer all around.
tips: Go in before 16:00.
Deer bite paper: keep maps and tickets in a pocket.

experience.hook: A 15 m bronze Buddha in one of the largest wooden halls in the world.
moments: Walk under the giant Nandaimon gate and look at the two huge guardian statues.
Go into the Great Buddha Hall and stand below the Buddha.
Find the pillar with a hole at its base, the size of the Buddha's nostril.
Feed the deer around the gate with the crackers you have left.
experience.tip: The hall closes at 17:00 in winter: go in before 16:00.

places.ja: 飛火野
places.blurb: A wide open field in Nara Park with a clear view of Wakakusa hill: fireworks at 18:15, the whole hill set on fire at 18:30.
tips: Cancelled in bad weather, with no second date.
Trains back are crowded: walk to Kintetsu-Nara by 19:15.

experience.hook: 600 fireworks, then the whole Wakakusa hill on fire, seen from an open field.
moments: Get to Tobihino field by 17:45 and stand with a clear view east to the hill.
At 18:15 watch the fireworks over Wakakusa-yama.
At 18:30 the dry grass is lit and the fire climbs the whole hill.
Walk back to Kintetsu-Nara with the crowd by about 19:15.
experience.tip: It is cancelled in bad weather, with no second date: check the official site that afternoon. Dress for standing still at about 0 °C.

places.ja: 鈴鹿サーキット
places.blurb: The Japanese F1 track. In the park you drive an EV kart on the real East Course; no licence needed.

info.label: Jan 24 hours
info.value: 10:00–17:00 (official park calendar, checked Sep 26, 2026; open Jan 22–25 only)

info.label: EV kart
info.value: About ¥2,000 per kart, up to 3 people (Asoview, online only). Runs only about 12:00–13:15 in late January (Jan 24, 2026: 12:10–13:20); 2027 times come out on Dec 1, 2026

info.label: Access
info.value: Kintetsu Shiroko Station + Mie Kotsu bus, 20 min

tips: The park is closed Jan 26–29; Jan 24 is one of 4 open days.
Buy the kart slot on Asoview on Dec 1, 2026, for about 12:30.

places.en: Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology
places.ja: トヨタ産業技術記念館
places.blurb: Toyota's first red-brick loom factory: looms, then cars built step by step with robot demos.
tips: Open on Sunday; Toyota Kaikan in Toyota City is closed on Sundays.

experience.hook: From wooden looms to cars, in the red-brick factory where Toyota began.
moments: Go straight to the Automobile Pavilion.
Watch a car body go from pressed steel to a welded shell.
See the first Toyota cars and engines up close.
If time is left, hear the old looms run in the Textile Machinery Pavilion.
experience.tip: Last entry 16:30: you have about 1 h, so start with the cars.

places.ja: 伏見稲荷大社
places.blurb: Thousands of red torii gates up the hill. At 7:00 the tunnels are almost empty.

info.label: From Namba
info.value: Keihan line from Yodoyabashi, about 45 min

tips: Walk to the Yotsutsuji viewpoint (about 40 min up) and back.

places.ja: 金閣寺
places.blurb: The gold pavilion. If snow fell in the night, it has a white roof: only 1–3 mornings a winter.
tips: Be at the gate at 9:00, before the tour buses.

places.ja: 黒門市場
places.blurb: A covered market street: grilled scallops, wagyu skewers, fruit and cooked seafood.
tips: Aoki: choose grilled and cooked stalls, not raw.

experience.hook: Osaka's kitchen market: brunch from the stalls, all cooked.
moments: Walk in from the Nippombashi end and look at a few stalls first.
Eat a grilled scallop and a wagyu skewer at the stall counter.
Try a cup of cut fruit (strawberries, melon) for dessert.
Walk south along Sakaisuji to Den Den Town.
experience.tip: Ask for food grilled (焼いてください) at seafood stalls. Prices vary a lot: compare two or three stalls first.

places.ja: 日本橋でんでんタウン・オタロード
places.blurb: Osaka's Akihabara: electronics on Sakaisuji and the side street Otaroad full of figure, game and doujin shops.
tips: Animate and Melonbooks are 2 min apart.

places.ja: JDM PARK / LB DRIVE-IN
places.romaji: Jē Dī Emu Pāku / Eru Bī Doraibu In
places.blurb: Liberty Walk's wide-body cars, goods shop and a Sanuki udon shop, opened in 2025.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Official site 11:00–21:00 daily; Instagram 11:00–19:00, closed Thu

tips: Wednesday is open on both sources; do not go on Thursday.
Taxis at Izumi-Sunagawa are not certain: ask the shop to call one, or walk the 1.7 km (about 22 min).

places.ja: 戎橋
places.blurb: The Glico sign and the canal lights. Takoyaki and okonomiyaki all along Dotonbori.
tips: Busy until late; keep bags in front.

experience.hook: The Glico running man and Dotonbori's neon over the canal.
moments: Stand on Ebisubashi bridge and take the photo with the Glico sign behind you.
Walk down to the canal walk for the neon reflections on the water.
Look at the giant crab, octopus and fugu signs along Dotonbori.
Walk 5 minutes to Hozenji Yokocho for dinner.
experience.tip: The bridge is packed in the evening: keep your phone and bag in front of you.

places.ja: 大阪国際空港（伊丹）
places.blurb: The city airport for domestic flights. Small and fast; JAL includes a 20 kg bag. The airport bus from Nara stops at the JAL North Terminal.

info.label: Flight
info.value: JAL 11:45 → New Chitose 13:30, Thu Jan 28, ¥13,030 incl. 20 kg bag (Google Flights, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Bus
info.value: Nara Kotsu airport bus, JR Nara (East exit, stop 4) 09:15 → Itami North Terminal (JAL) 10:46, ¥1,750 (narakotsu.co.jp, Sep 27, 2026)

tips: Bag drop closes 20 min before departure.

experience.hook: The easy airport: one JAL flight to Hokkaido.
moments: Get off the airport bus at the North Terminal (JAL).
Drop the bags at the JAL counter (20 kg each included).
Buy a bento, onigiri or 551 pork buns for lunch at the gate.
Fly north and watch the snow start below.
experience.tip: JAL closes bag drop 20 min before departure: you have about 40 min spare.

places.ja: 新千歳空港
places.blurb: Hokkaido's main airport. You land here from Osaka on Thu Jan 28 and fly to Narita from here on Mon Feb 1.

info.label: To Sapporo
info.value: JR Rapid Airport, 37 min; by car about 1 h 10

info.label: Your car
info.value: HAYAKU RENT A CAR meets you here (place agreed by email)

tips: Snow delays are common: keep the phone numbers of the car company and your hotels.

11.blurb: You land from Itami at 13:30 (JAL, domestic terminal), take the bags and meet HAYAKU RENT A CAR for the WRX STI.

info.label: Car
info.value: HAYAKU RENT A CAR meets you at about 14:00 (place agreed by email)

tips: Snow delays are common: keep the phone numbers of the car company and the container house host.

15.blurb: The flight to Narita: Peach MM576 at 12:00 from the domestic terminal. Drop the bags at the Peach counter, then buy a Hokkaido ekiben (boxed lunch) for the plane.

info.label: Flight
info.value: Peach MM576, New Chitose 12:00 → Narita Terminal 1 13:50

info.label: Bags
info.value: Checked bags booked with the ticket; be at the Peach counter by about 11:15

info.label: Lunch
info.value: Ekiben and Hokkaido sweets on the 2F shopping floor of the domestic terminal

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: No refund on a domestic flight: you get it at Narita when you leave Japan

tips: Peach is strict about bag weight and size: weigh the bags at the hotel or at the airport scales first.

places.en: Toyota Rent a Car New Chitose Airport Poplar
places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 新千歳空港ポプラ店
places.blurb: Check in at the rental counter in the arrivals hall, then a free 9-min shuttle to the shop. Studless tyres are standard in Hokkaido.

info.label: Rent
info.value: Thu Jan 28 14:10 → Sun Jan 31 about 10:00, one way to Sapporo-ekimae

info.label: Car
info.value: Ask for 4WD (e.g. Corolla Cross / Yaris Cross 4WD)

info.label: One-way
info.value: Allowed inside Hokkaido; fee not checked (small, check when you book)

tips: Book now (6 months ahead): late-January 4WD cars sell out.
Give your flight number when you book: the shuttle needs it.
Skis fit inside a small SUV; the ski gear is rented at Hirafu anyway.

places.ja: ステイリゾートニセコ
places.blurb: A small self check-in hotel in Kutchan town, 5 min on foot from JR Kutchan Station. Every room has a mini kitchen; 15 min by car to Grand Hirafu, 50 min to Rusutsu.

info.label: Room
info.value: Twin (bunk bed) with bath and toilet, mini kitchen, non-smoking (the whole hotel is non-smoking)

info.label: Price
info.value: ¥81,360 per room for 3 nights, room only = ≈ ¥40,700 per person (Rakuten, Sep 26, 2026; 9 rooms left)

info.label: Address
info.value: Kita 1-jo Nishi 2-20-5, Kutchan (pin: nearest block point)

info.label: Parking
info.value: Free car park 200 m away (map at the front)

tips: Replaces Hotel Three M: on Sep 26, 2026 it had only smoking twins left for these nights.
No staff at night: phone numbers are at the check-in machine.
The twin has a bunk bed; the sister hotel STAY LIVING NISEKO (Kita 2-jo Nishi 1) has the same rooms and price.

places.ja: セイコーマート 倶知安
places.blurb: Hokkaido's own konbini, with a Hot Chef counter that cooks katsudon and fried chicken in the shop.
tips: Buy the next breakfast here too: the container house has no breakfast, but it has a small kitchen.

experience.hook: Hokkaido's own konbini, with hot meals cooked in the shop.
moments: Look for the orange Seicomart sign with a HOT CHEF counter.
Take the katsudon, butadon or fried chicken from the warm shelf.
Ask them to warm it (温めてください) if it is not warm.
experience.tip: Buy Seicomart's own-brand drinks and snacks: they are cheaper than other konbini.

experience.hook: Buy tomorrow's breakfast before the drive to the container house.
moments: Take bread, onigiri, yogurt and drinks for 2 for the morning.
Add a hot snack from the HOT CHEF counter if you are still hungry.
Pay and walk back to the car.
experience.tip: The container house has a small kitchen: you can warm food there.

experience.hook: A hot dinner to take back to the container house.
moments: Take the HOT CHEF katsudon and fried chicken from the warm shelf.
Ask them to warm it (温めてください) if it is not warm.
Buy tomorrow's breakfast too.
experience.tip: Go before 17:00: the HOT CHEF shelf can be empty later in the evening.

places.en: Grand Hirafu .Base (rental shop and ski school desk)
places.ja: グラン・ヒラフ .Base（レンタル・スクール）
places.blurb: The official rental shop at the Ace Gondola base. Rent skis, boots, poles, helmet and the ski jacket and pants here, and leave them in the daily storage overnight. Gloves and goggles you buy in Kutchan.

info.label: Ski wear
info.value: Jacket + pants ¥16,200 for 2 days (without goggles, gloves, beanie)

info.label: Your set, 2 days
info.value: ¥36,900 per person, ¥33,210 with the 10% early code (2026-27 price list)

tips: Reserve online before Oct 31, 2026 with code TGHRental109 (10% off, shown on en.grand-hirafu.jp/snow/rentals).
Daily storage: leave the gear at the shop between the two ski days.
Pick up the reserved set: skis, boots, poles, helmet, jacket + pants. Wear your own gloves and goggles.
Buy lift tickets at the counter or online the day before.
Leave all the gear in the daily storage at 15:50 for tomorrow.
Take the gear out of the daily storage at 10:45.
Return everything by about 12:25, then walk to lunch.

places.ja: ニセコ東急 グラン・ヒラフ
places.blurb: The biggest Niseko slope, with light powder and Mt Yotei across the valley. Pegasis teaches Aoki on the beginner area on both days.

info.label: Lift ticket 2026–27 (Peak season, Dec 24 – Feb 28)
info.value: Hirafu & Hanazono 1 day ¥11,800 online (¥12,500 at the counter); afternoon 4 h ¥8,400 online (¥8,900) (official ticket page; online sales not open yet)

info.label: Beginner area
info.value: Ace Family area (Ace Family lift, own ticket counter at its base)

info.label: Lesson
info.value: None: Pegasis teaches Aoki (a paid group lesson is in Japanese only)

tips: Pegasis: stay on marked runs; the gates to the backcountry need avalanche gear.
Start Aoki on the flat part at the bottom of the Ace Family area: walking with skis, snowplough, stopping; ride the lift only after that.

experience.hook: Light powder snow with Mt Yotei standing across the valley.
moments: Ride the Ace Family lift area, the gentle beginner slopes at the base.
Stop and look across the valley at Mt Yotei, a perfect white cone.
Warm up with a hot drink or lunch in a lodge.
experience.tip: Stay on marked runs: the gates to the backcountry need avalanche gear.

experience.hook: Aoki's first ski day: Pegasis teaches on the beginner area.
moments: Start on the flat part at the bottom of the Ace Family area: walking with skis on.
Practise the snowplough: skis in a V to slow down and stop.
Ride the Ace Family lift and come down slowly in long turns.
Afternoon runs together until 15:50.
experience.tip: Short breaks often: the first day on skis is tiring, and cold hands make it harder.

experience.hook: A last morning on the snow before the drift course.
moments: Take the gear out of storage and buy a short ticket.
Ski together on the Ace Family area until 12:15.
Look back at Mt Yotei from the top of the lift.
experience.tip: Stop at 12:15: you return the gear and drive to Rusutsu after lunch.

places.ja: ルスツリゾート 雪上ドリフト
places.blurb: A closed snow course at Rusutsu with Subaru, GT-R and GR Yaris cars. You drive yourself with an instructor next to you.

info.label: Ride-along (pro drives, 4 min)
info.value: Subaru B4 ¥17,000 per person for 1–2 people; slots 8:30, 10:00, 13:00, 15:00

info.label: Booking
info.value: Prepaid, by 17:00 the day before; cancel fee 10% from booking, 50% the day before, 100% after 17:00 the day before

info.label: Reception
info.value: Rusutsu Resort activity desk (open 08:00–16:00), shuttle to the River Wood car park

tips: Email activity@rusutsu.co.jp before booking: the site asks only for a driver's licence and does not say if a 1-year licence + IDP is accepted.
Bring passport, licence and IDP; alcohol check before driving.

experience.hook: Slide a 4WD Subaru sideways on a snow course.
moments: Check in at the Rusutsu Resort activity desk by about 14:30.
Ride out to the snow course with the staff.
15:00: Pegasis drives 30 minutes with the instructor; Aoki rides in the back seat.
Feel the rear step out and learn to catch it with the steering.
experience.tip: Wear warm shoes thin enough to feel the pedals. Filming is allowed: bring a phone mount.

places.ja: スープカレー GARAKU
places.blurb: Sapporo's famous soup curry: a thin spicy soup with big chicken and grilled vegetables.
tips: Expect a queue on Sunday: take a number and walk around until your turn.
You walk from Tanukikoji (12 min); the shop has no parking.

places.ja: トヨタレンタカー 札幌駅前店
places.blurb: Return the Hokkaido car here, 6 min on foot from JR Sapporo Station (east side, across Soseigawa-dori).
tips: Fill the tank before you return the car.

places.ja: ホテルルートイン札幌中央
places.blurb: A good-value business hotel with a public bath and free breakfast buffet, 5 min from Susukino and Daruma.

info.label: Price
info.value: Twin with breakfast ¥16,500 per room (Rakuten, Jan 31, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Laundry
info.value: Coin laundry in the hotel (Route Inn standard)

tips: Book the early-bird plan by about Jan 4.

places.ja: もいわ山
places.blurb: A ropeway and mini cable car to a viewpoint above the whole of Sapporo. Go up before sunset and stay for the lights.
tips: Free shuttle bus from the streetcar stop ロープウェイ入口.

places.ja: 成吉思汗だるま 本店
places.blurb: The most famous Jingisukan (grilled lamb) shop in Sapporo, since 1954: a small counter with dome pans.
tips: Cash is safest.
Your clothes will smell of lamb: wear the old jacket.

places.en: MEGA Don Quijote Sapporo Tanukikoji (24 h)
places.ja: MEGAドン・キホーテ 札幌狸小路本店
places.blurb: Last big shop before the flights: snacks, cosmetics and gifts, tax-free. Pegasis fills the suitcase here.

info.label: Tax-free
info.value: From ¥5,000 before tax, passport; refund at the airport from Nov 2026

info.label: Also
info.value: Luggage scale and a second small bag if the suitcase is full

tips: Weigh the suitcase: most checked bags must be 23 kg or less.

places.ja: 自家製麺 杵屋麦丸 成田国際空港第1ターミナル店
places.blurb: Self-service udon made in the shop, with tempura and rice balls. In the Terminal 1 Central Building, 5F, before security.
tips: Pegasis eats here while he waits for Aoki. Both flights use Terminal 1.
Other choice on T1 4F: Tonkatsu Saboten.

places.ja: 炭火串焼 かっぺ亭 新宿思い出横丁本店
places.blurb: A charcoal yakitori bar in Omoide Yokocho with 42 seats, so two people get in easily. Cheap skewers and drinks.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Mon–Fri 16:00–23:00, Sat/Sun 12:00–23:00, no closed day (Tabelog, Sep 2026; Omoide Yokocho site)

tips: Cash is safest (the Omoide site says cash only).

places.ja: 珉亭
places.blurb: An old Chinese diner famous for pink fried rice and "ra-chan" (ramen + fried rice). 2 minutes from SHELTER.
tips: Everything is cooked: good for Aoki.
60 seats: dinner takes 30–45 min.

places.ja: 魚べい 渋谷道玄坂店
places.blurb: Touch-screen sushi: plates come on an express lane. There are cooked plates too (fried chicken, egg, noodles).
tips: Aoki can order only cooked plates.

places.ja: アネスト岩田スカイラウンジ（大観山）
places.blurb: The food court and tea lounge at the top of the Hakone Turnpike, with Fuji over Lake Ashi. Ramen, soba and curry.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Food court about 09:00–16:30; 2F tea lounge weekdays 10:00–15:30

tips: No winter closing was found, but the 2027 menu is not confirmed.

places.en: Tochuken ekiben stand, Mishima Shinkansen platform
places.ja: 桃中軒 三島駅 新幹線ホーム売店
places.blurb: The local ekiben maker since 1891, with a stand on the Shinkansen platform. The Ashitaka beef sukiyaki bento is cooked, not raw.
tips: Buy it on the platform, eat it on the Kodama (3 h, no change).

places.ja: すき家 近鉄奈良駅前店
places.blurb: A fast beef-bowl chain shop next to Kintetsu-Nara Station. Quick and warm before the cold wait at the fire.
tips: Kamameshi Shizuka is not possible: last order 16:00 on Saturday.
Festival food stalls may also be open on the field.

places.ja: アドベンチャイナ（鈴鹿サーキットパーク）
places.blurb: The ramen shop in the park, in Adventure Village. Adventure Grill (burgers) and AdvenCurry are next to it.

info.label: Menu
info.value: Spicy miso ramen ¥1,250; tanmen ¥1,300; curry ¥1,500; burger ¥1,270 (official foods page)

tips: Which park restaurants open on Jan 22–25 is not published: check the foods page in January.

places.ja: 松屋 日本橋店
places.blurb: A 24-hour gyudon chain shop by Nippombashi Station, 11 min on foot from the apartment. Hot Japanese breakfast sets for about ¥500.
tips: Order at the ticket machine by the door.

places.en: Shirakaba Sanso ramen, Hokkaido Ramen Dojo (New Chitose)
places.ja: 麺処 白樺山荘 新千歳空港店
places.blurb: Sapporo miso ramen in the Ramen Dojo, domestic terminal 3F, before security. Fast: 30 minutes is enough.
tips: Pin is the terminal point.

places.ja: ラーメン店 なかま
places.blurb: A local ramen shop by Kutchan Station, open late.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Mon, Thu, Fri, Sat 11:00–14:00 / 17:00–24:00; Sun 11:00–24:00; closed Tue, Wed (Tabelog)

tips: Closes early if the soup runs out.

places.ja: 望羊荘
places.blurb: An old family lodge on the lower Hirafu slopes with cheap katsu curry and ramen, much cheaper than the resort restaurants.
tips: 2026–27 hours not confirmed.

places.ja: POWDERHOOD RESTAURANT & TAPROOM（ALPEN NODE）
places.blurb: Burgers and hot food in ALPEN NODE at the Ace Gondola base plaza, 5 min from .Base.

info.label: Hours
info.value: Winter daytime from about 10:30 (two sources disagree on the closing time)

tips: Backup: the food court in the Hirafu Welcome Center.

places.ja: 居酒屋 餃子の肉村
places.blurb: A small local gyoza izakaya in Kutchan town. House gyoza at local prices.
tips: Opens at 18:00.

places.ja: 奈良公園
places.blurb: About 1,300 free-roaming deer on open grass between Kofukuji and Kasuga Taisha. Buy crackers and the deer bow to you for them.
tips: Show empty hands when the crackers are finished, or the deer keep pushing.
Deer bite paper: keep maps and tickets in a pocket.

experience.hook: Bow to a wild deer, and it bows back before it takes the cracker.
moments: Walk 10 minutes from Kintetsu-Nara Station and meet the first deer on the grass.
Buy a pack of deer crackers (shika senbei) at a stall, bow, and the deer bows back.
Walk past Kofukuji's five-storey pagoda with the deer around you.
Eat hot mochi at Nakatanidou near the station, famous for its fast pounding show.
experience.tip: Hide paper maps and snacks: the deer eat paper. Hold the crackers high until you are ready.

places.ja: とんかつ がんこ 奈良店
places.blurb: A tonkatsu restaurant of the Ganko chain on the Higashimuki shopping street, 5 minutes from Kintetsu-Nara. Early dinner before the hill fire.

info.label: Hours
info.value: 11:00–21:15 (last order 20:45), every day (gankofood.co.jp and Google Maps, Sep 26, 2026)

tips: Come at 16:00: after 17:00 the festival crowd fills the street.

places.ja: スポーツたきぐち
places.blurb: A local ski and sports shop on the station street in Kutchan, about 20 min by car from the container house. Buy ski gloves and goggles here for both ski days.
tips: Backup: Bigban Winter Sports in Kutchan (used gear, 10:00–19:00 every day).
Buy a beanie too if you have no warm hat: the helmet goes over it.

places.ja: 矢場とん 名古屋駅エスカ店
places.blurb: The Nagoya miso-katsu chain in the ESCA underground mall on the Shinkansen side of Nagoya Station: dinner 3 min from the platform.
tips: Table bookings are possible: useful on a Sunday evening.

places.ja: 鵬天閣 新館
places.blurb: Yokohama Chinatown, the biggest in Japan: 500+ shops inside 4 painted gates. Dinner at Hotenkaku, known for pan-fried xiaolongbao (焼き小籠包), then a walk to the Kanteibyo temple lit up at night.
tips: The pan-fried xiaolongbao are very hot inside: bite a small hole first.

experience.hook: Pan-fried xiaolongbao in Japan's biggest Chinatown.
moments: Park in a coin car park and walk in through one of the big gates.
Eat hot pan-fried xiaolongbao at Hotenkaku: bite a small hole first, the soup inside is very hot.
Walk past the colourful Kanteibyo temple and the lit gates.
Back to the car at about 18:40 for Daikoku.
experience.tip: The street stands sell the same buns to take away if the shop is full.

places.ja: 江戸三
places.blurb: A ryokan of small separate cottages inside Nara Park, opened in 1907. Deer walk past your door. Tatami room, yukata, and dinner served in your room.

info.label: Night
info.value: Wed Jan 27, the last night before the flight (a room was free on Rakuten, Sep 27, 2026)

info.label: Price
info.value: "Wakakusa nabe" hot-pot plan, fully cooked: ¥61,600 for 2 with dinner and breakfast (kaiseki plan ¥57,200 has sashimi) (Rakuten, Sep 26, 2026)

info.label: Access
info.value: Kintetsu-Nara 15 min on foot; Osaka-Namba about 40 min by Kintetsu

tips: Book the hot-pot plan and write "no raw fish, cooked food only" in the booking note.
Email first: ask if they accept 2 suitcases by Yamato on Jan 27 before check-in.
The cottage rooms have their own toilet; the bath is shared.
Jan 28: breakfast at 08:00, then ask them to call a taxi to JR Nara for the 09:15 airport bus.

places.ja: 松阪牛焼肉M 法善寺横丁店
places.blurb: Top Matsusaka beef grilled at your table, in the old stone lane of Hozenji Yokocho next to Dotonbori. The special dinner of the trip.
tips: Book a table for 18:30 on Tue Jan 26.
Check its closed day on TableCheck before you book.
Everything is cooked on the grill: fine for Aoki.

places.ja: 京都拉麺小路
places.blurb: A floor of ramen shops from all over Japan on the 10th floor of the Kyoto Station building. Buy a ticket at the machine, sit, eat.
tips: Take the escalators on the west side of the Station building up to 10F.

places.ja: 串かつだるま 道頓堀店
places.blurb: Osaka deep-fried skewers (kushikatsu) at the famous Daruma chain. No second dip in the sauce!
tips: After dinner walk the small bars of Ura-Namba if you still have energy.

experience.hook: Osaka's fried skewers, with one strict rule: no second dip.
